questions.question: A shopkeeper buys a watch for Rs. 400 and sells it at a 20% profit. What is the selling price?
A can finish a job in 12 days and B can finish it in 24 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.solution: Work per day together = 1/12 + 1/24 = 3/24 = 1/8. So they finish in 8 days.

questions.question: Find the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.solution: Differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12. Next term = 30 + 12 = 42.

questions.question: Pointing to a man, a woman said, "His mother is the only daughter of my mother." How is the woman related to the man?
questions.solution: The only daughter of the woman's mother is the woman herself. So the man's mother is the woman, i.e. she is his mother.
